scope: qubit MBQC only (flows, measurement calculus, small statevector); Graphix is not a CV/GBS simulator and no CV claim is made

environment.native_code_used_by_this_benchmark: none on the PhotoGraphiQ side (flows and calculus.qubit are pure Python/NumPy); Graphix uses numba-JIT GF(2) and statevector kernels
environment.precision: complex128 statevectors; GF(2) uint8 linear algebra
environment.memory_note: tracemalloc_peak_bytes = peak Python/NumPy heap during one warm call; it does not capture numba NRT allocations or other C-level allocations

semantics.flows: same open graph (graph, ordered inputs/outputs, plane/Pauli labels); output: existence + a flow with layered order. Ratio column compares PhotoGraphiQ find_* (search + built-in verify) with Graphix to_*_or_none + check_well_formed.
semantics.standardize: same non-standard input (Graphix XZCorrections.to_pattern of the Graphix flow); output: an equivalent NEMC standard pattern.
semantics.signal_shift: same standard input (Graphix standard form); PhotoGraphiQ appends S commands, Graphix returns the signal dict (same information).
semantics.statevector: same standardized pattern, same fixed branch, input |+>^k; output: normalized output state. PhotoGraphiQ run_branch with inputs as N commands.
not_applicable: PhotoGraphiQ full Kraus map (run_branch with inputs) vs Graphix single state: different tasks, not compared
Graphix tensor-network / density-matrix backends: no PhotoGraphiQ qubit counterpart
